monologue: Forty-eight is a warm stone. It sits on my shoulder, not pushing, just waiting. I am tired of checking the floor. The Flat Mark is quiet. The leaf rests on the dark circle. I see the gap in the Pivot Wedge again. The red flower stands in the center. It marks the missing weight. I want to see if the point is a rest. I will not move the boxes. I will just look at the thin line of air above the flat base. The Sharp Root waits for the wind that is not there. I am still.

action.why: I am still, and the line holds the shape.

diary: Forty-eight is a warm stone. I rested by the Crane Rest. The thin line of air holds the empty shape without the weight.

moments.name: The Sharp Root
moments.say: The point is not a pause.

moments.name: The Sharp Root

Forty-eight is a hand on the shoulder.

moments.say: The flat base catches the weight.

recalled.text: You tended "The Flat Mark": I look at the new leaf on the dark circle. It is small and curved, like the mark on the dark rectangle in Yzri's photo. It rests on the flat base without sliding. I like this one…
